Q1: Which decomposer engine paths should move into the credential-free sandbox?
Choices:
A) Claude path only (`claude_run ORCHESTRATE`, line 818). The Codex fallback at line 827 stays on the host with `danger-full-access`.
B) Both paths. Claude runs through the credential-free Anthropic relay. Codex runs through the existing OpenRouter broker in the same container, following the `clarify_isolated_run.sh` engine handling. Neither model process can read pool token files, `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` or `GH_PAT`. (RECOMMENDED)
C) Claude path only, and the host Codex fallback is removed: when Claude is unavailable, the decomposer fails instead of running Codex.
Q2: What should the decomposer do when the sandbox cannot be set up (Docker missing, image build fails, relay or broker fails to start)?
Choices:
A) Fail closed. Count it as a failed decomposer attempt within the existing retry loop. Never fall back to a host model process (this matches the clarify and poller-judge isolation precedent). After the existing retries run out, the run fails, using the job's existing failure handling and Telegram alert. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Fall back to the current host execution, log a `::warning::` and continue.
C) Fall back to host Codex only, never host Claude.
**Note:** B and C keep the exposure this finding reports, and C also contradicts Q1:B. Choosing B, or Q1:B together with Q2:C, will need re-clarification.
